messages.subject: No DRUG today, and summer schedule
parts:
Hi Everyone!

I hope you had a wonderful end to the spring quarter. DRUG will not be meeting today, and we will be taking a break for the first part of summer. We may meet sporadically through June-July, but we will start back up regular meetings in August.

Happy coding!
Taylor
